QUOTE: Python reaches the engine through plain `ctypes` over the C ABI. There is no pybind11, no Cython, and no C++ crossing.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names ctypes over the C ABI (`ctypes.CDLL(librentropic.so)`) and explicitly rules out pybind11 and Cython, so no compiled extension module is involved.
